title: 第11章 王冬出现，找茬霍雨浩，生理性厌恶
slug: 斗罗千仞雪穿绝世重振武魂殿
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

霍雨浩还没做出什么反应，却不曾想他身后之人反应却大得很。

“十一岁，魂力十五级，还是十年魂环！这样的实力和天赋居然能通过史莱克学院的招生？开玩笑的吧？”

雌雄难辨的声音入耳，霍雨浩不禁皱起眉头，随后猛地转身。

在视线相撞的瞬间，霍雨浩一愣。

这男生好生漂亮，虽然不及老师的倾城之姿，但也是绝色了。

不过老师是女子，一个男子长这么漂亮？

霍雨浩想到这眉头蹙起，那点惊艳立刻消失不见了。

而眼前的男生，那副高高在上瞧不起霍雨浩的姿态，也将这份惊艳削弱三分。

一头粉蓝色短发，粉蓝色大眼，五官精致到极致，身量纤细修长，一双大长腿格外吸睛，使得身后几个女子早就满脸通红，低声尖叫了。

但这一切都被王冬忽视了，他指着霍雨浩，声音带着指责和傲慢。

“这样的人都能进史莱克学院，凭什么？不会是什么大贵族走后门来的吧？既然是走后门就滚到一边去，还假模假样的走跟我们这样天才一样的通道规规矩矩进入学院，恶不恶心！”

“你说谁恶心？”

“说的就是你！本少爷最讨厌特权人，简直碍我的眼，走开！”

王冬说着就要大步上前将人撞开，这完全踩在了霍雨浩的底线上。

于是王冬的肩膀狠狠撞在了霍雨浩身上，却并没有将人撞开，这让王冬惊讶了。

“哟，居然能顶住我的一撞，小子，还可以啊！不过你也只有这点莽力了。滚！”

“道歉！”

“什么？”

“我说你，道歉！”

“你让本少爷道歉？怎么我说错了吗？你难道不是走后门，不是恶心吗？还在这里给我摆什么要自尊的模样，斗罗大陆，强者为尊，你弱可没理！”

说完王冬不管他了，直接开始跟老师报名。

赵老师见此，瞥了一眼霍雨浩充满血丝的眼，思考了一瞬后决定不管了，先工作要紧。

帮王冬审核后，资料齐全，随后又让她告知实力，随后释放武魂。

王冬闻言笑了，“好的，老师。王冬，十一岁，武魂光明女神蝶，26级强攻系战魂师！”

“26级？！十一岁的大魂师啊！快看，他的魂环配置是一黄一紫啊！”

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Huo Yuhao hadn't made any reaction yet, but he never thought that the person behind him would react very loudly.

"Eleven years old, with a fifteenth level soul power, and a ten-year soul ring! With such strength and talent, you can actually pass Shrek Academy's admissions? Are you kidding me?"

Huo Yuhao couldn't help but frown when he heard the indistinguishable male and female voice, and then turned around suddenly.

The moment their eyes collided, Huo Yuhao was stunned.

This boy is so beautiful. Although he is not as stunning as the teacher, he is still stunning.

But the teacher is a woman, how can a man be so beautiful?

Huo Yuhao frowned at the thought, and the surprise immediately disappeared.

And the boy in front of him looked down on Huo Yuhao in a condescending manner, which also weakened the amazingness by three points.

She has short pink-blue hair, big pink-blue eyes, extremely delicate facial features, a slender figure, and a pair of long legs that are particularly eye-catching. The women behind her have already blushed and screamed in low voices.

But all of this was ignored by Wang Dong. He pointed at Huo Yuhao with an accusatory and arrogant voice.

"Why can such a person enter Shrek Academy? It's not like some big noble came through the back door, right? Since he's going through the back door, get out of here, and then he pretends to walk through the same passage as geniuses like us and enter the academy in a regular manner. Isn't it disgusting!"

"Who are you calling disgusting?"

"It's you I'm talking about! I hate privileged people the most. They are simply an eyesore to me. Go away!"

Wang Dong said that he was about to stride forward and knock the person away, which completely stepped on Huo Yuhao's bottom line.

So Wang Dong's shoulder hit Huo Yuhao hard, but he didn't knock him away, which surprised Wang Dong.

"Oh, you can actually withstand my collision, boy, it's not bad! But you only have this much strength. Get out!"

"Apologise!"

"What?"

"I told you to apologize!"

"You asked me to apologize? Did I say something wrong? Didn't you go through the back door? Isn't it disgusting? Why are you still here showing me how to be self-respecting? In Douluo Continent, the strong are respected. You are weak and have nothing to do with it!"

After saying that, Wang Dong ignored him and started to sign up with the teacher directly.

Seeing this, Teacher Zhao glanced at Huo Yuhao's bloodshot eyes. After thinking for a moment, he decided to ignore it and work first.

After helping Wang Dong review the information, she was asked to tell her her strength and then release her martial spirit.

Wang Dong smiled when he heard this, "Okay, teacher. Wang Dong, eleven years old, Wuhun Light Goddess Die, level 26 attack-type battle soul master!"

"Level 26?! An eleven-year-old great soul master! Look, his soul ring configuration is one yellow and one purple!"
